scope: All 97 residual Czech/Slovak obsah- and Slovene vsebu- containment predicates in the live Latin reader.
choice: Normalize all twelve observed inflection types to the already-adopted official sodrživati containment paradigm, including the malformed plural vsebujeju and vsebijejut variants; preserve content nouns and unrelated drž-/zadrž- lexemes handled by EDIT-0024.
motivation: EDIT-0024 removed the Russian-like soderž- versus South-like sadrž- mixture but a second national-source layer remained: Czech/Slovak obsah- and Slovene vsebu-. The official type-1 containment entry explicitly lists those as native translations of canonical sȯdŕživati. One edition-wide technical predicate is clearer and more pan-Slavic than alternating national synonyms by source paper.
alternatives_rejected: Keep obsah- and vsebu- as useful variation; their clustering by source paper exposes translation provenance rather than semantic distinction.
Use imati or vključati everywhere; those weaken strict mathematical containment.
Change content nouns or separate hold/retain verbs; they are distinct meanings and remain outside this pass.

official_dictionary.entry: id 2163 sȯdŕživati, type 1, contain; the entry explicitly gives Czech/Slovak obsahovat and Slovene vsebovati as native comparators

evidence.prior_decision: ISV019-EDIT-0024 established sodrživati for mathematical containment and separately preserved sodržanje for content.
